title: Field Work: Getting Useful Data
description: Placeholder module (content-agnostic proof). Replaced when authored material lands.

objectives.label: Turn curiosity into a testable question

blocks.text: An investigation starts with a question you can answer with the time and tools you actually have. If you cannot picture the measurement, the question is too big.

blocks.question: Which question could you answer with a small measurement?

options.label: How many people walked past this corner in ten minutes?
Do people care about air quality?

blocks.explanation: Counting for ten minutes is a measurement you can repeat and compare. Nice and care are opinions with no number attached.

blocks.title: Punchline
blocks.text: A small sample you actually took beats a big number you guessed.
